record.text: Which project is commercialising a drive-by-wire system for the steer, brake and gas functions of a production car so that people with a wide range of physical disabilities can drive using joysticks or handlebars instead of conventional controls, with the same modular system also serving teleoperated and autonomous off-highway vehicles?
record.reference_answer: Joysteer 3.0. The project is bringing to market a modular drive-by-wire system covering the steer, brake and gas functions of a vehicle: electronic driving systems plus individually adapted man-machine interfaces such as joysticks or handlebars take the place of the conventional controls, so that people with a wide range of disabilities can drive an adapted standard production car with fast, redundant and predictable response. The same modular architecture, extended with remote GPS-based access, is aimed at teleoperated and autonomous vehicles that remove workers from risky off-highway settings such as construction, mining, agriculture-forestry, airport handling and rescue.
record.notes: Seed: 807968, the only project tagged euroSciVoc leaf 'drive by wire' (re-executed this pass: COUNT(DISTINCT projectID)=1). Question composed after reading the project's objective and full report; borrowed verbatim vocabulary: 'drive-by-wire', 'steer, brake and gas', 'joysticks or handlebars', 'conventional controls', 'teleoperated', 'off-highway'. Pooled search at k=10 returned 22 distinct projects; 807968 ranks 1 in all four conditions. Adjudications (OUT unless noted): 807968 IN (objective and report describe exactly this system); 769989 DRIVEMODE OUT (modular distributed drivetrain for electric/hybrid vehicles, no disability adaptation); 685105 DRIVING RIG OUT (driving simulator that assesses disabled people's driving skills, not a vehicle control system); 827005 PAMPAS OUT (lightweight composite car seats); 752979 MACROSS OUT (vehicular cloud multimedia for autonomous driving); 816417 F3D-Fastsight-PoC OUT (laser imaging collision-avoidance sensor); 763497 Elbee OUT (drive-from-wheelchair vehicle for wheelchair users; feasibility/commercialisation study, no drive-by-wire or joystick control claim in its text); 723051 L3Pilot OUT (piloting automated driving on roads); 823116 BB6S Active OUT (e-bike ABS); 101010128 comAUX OUT (auxiliary hydraulic/pneumatic components for commercial vehicles); 675999 ITEAM OUT (training network on multi-actuated ground vehicles); 952189 5G-Blueprint OUT (5G teleoperated transport, no disability driving); 762960 SIRENA OUT (stair climber for disabled and elderly); 824250 EVC1000 OUT (in-wheel powertrain components, mentions brake-by-wire but no disability adaptation); 723616 THOMAS OUT (mobile dual-arm manufacturing robots); 645736 EVE OUT (active chassis systems for ground vehicles); 836777 EMP OUT (motion planning software for autonomous cars); 881807 PIVOT2 OUT (rail vehicle braking and doors); 768908 FreeWheel OUT (reconfigurable wheelchair/urban mobility platform); 731330 VERSATILE OUT (reconfigurable production-line robotics); 731993 AUTOPILOT OUT (IoT-assisted automated driving); 859529 STRINGHANDBIKE OUT (push-pull wheelchair accessory). Gold project 807968, acronym "Joysteer 3.0", title "A New Drive-by-Wire Technology for People with Disabilities and Industrial Applications".

Satisfying passages, verbatim from `get_project_text(807968)`:

objective: "People with physical disabilities require adaptable systems to provide them with new reliable and easy to operate driving solutions, as they cannot drive using conventional car controls. They need an adaptation of standard production cars... Current car adaptation solutions are enabled by drive-by-wire technologies, which consist of man-machine-interfaces (MMIs) and electronic driving systems used to compensate disabilities. With this technology, the driver does not have to use conventional controls such as the steering wheel, instead, driving is facilitated by individually adapted MMIs like joysticks or handlebars... Overcoming these issues, joysteer3.0 is a novel drive-by-wire system offering the best drivability, safety and reliability standards for steer, brake and gas, allowing people with a wide range of disabilities the operation of a car. Its high modularity together with its new remote GPS-based capabilities address a new market segment for safety-critical industrial applications."

report/summary: "Drive-by-wire technologies (DbW) comprise electronic driving systems and human-machine interfaces that replace the mechanical components operated by the driver... the automation trend is pushing original manufacturers (OEMs) towards the implementation of new systems that enable highly-automated & autonomous vehicles (AV) to remove workers from risky off-highway applications (e.g. construction, mining, agriculture-forestry, airport handling, rescue, etc.) joysteer 3.0 is our novel DbW system offering the best drivability, safety and reliability standards for the steer, brake and gas functions of vehicles."

record.text: How do EU-funded projects whose work centres on antihydrogen differ in what each one sets out to do with it - which property of the anti-atom it aims to measure and by what apparatus, or, if it measures none itself, what it instead builds for the experiments that do?
record.reference_answer: Three projects centre on antihydrogen and they take on different pieces of it. ANGRAM proposed a 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration of antihydrogen - enough to reveal the sign of gravity acting on antimatter and test the Weak Equivalence Principle - using a rotating three-grating moire deflectometer that needs neither position resolution nor time-of-flight, with the atoms made in the AEgIS apparatus by three-body recombination of antiprotons and positrons; it reported that Rydberg-state antihydrogen interacts too heavily with the atoms of material gratings, so the gratings were never produced and the work shifted to antiproton annihilation-at-rest measurements compared against GEANT4 and FLUKA. QUARTET measures a spectroscopic property instead: the classical Lamb shift in the microwave region, pursued for antihydrogen on the ELENA beamline at CERN alongside a parallel muonium campaign at PSI, where agreement with matter would give the first determination of the antiproton charge radius; its setup was commissioned with protons and then adapted to the GBAR beamline. AVA measures no antihydrogen property itself - it is a training network for 15 Fellows whose three work packages (facility design and optimization around the ELENA upgrade to CERN's Antiproton Decelerator, beam diagnostics, and antimatter experiments) build the simulation codes, prototype detectors and beam quality that CPT tests by high-resolution spectroscopy on antihydrogen and antimatter gravity experiments depend on.

All three read in full via get_project_text before the question existed. Pooled search on the final question text, k=10, all four conditions, 20 distinct projects. IN: 748826 ANGRAM (objective: 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration for antihydrogen with a rotating three-grating moire deflectometer); 101019414 QUARTET (objective: Antihydrogen spectroscopy on the ELENA beamline, classical Lamb-Shift, antiproton charge radius); 721559 AVA (objective: CPT tests by high-resolution spectroscopy on antihydrogen and gravity experiments as the physics its ELENA-era accelerator, diagnostics and simulation R&D serves; report work packages Facility Design, Beam Diagnostics, Antimatter Experiments). OUT with reason: 804383 ANTI-ATOM - positron/positronium many-body theory, antihydrogen named once in the report summary as background on what other laboratories study, no antihydrogen work of its own; 852818 STEP - portable antiproton reservoir, Penning-trap CPT and cyclotron-frequency measurements on single antiprotons, no antihydrogen; 832848 FunI - Penning-trap magnetic moments and masses of (anti)protons and highly charged ions, no antihydrogen; 818053 Mu-MASS - muonium laser spectroscopy, no antihydrogen in objective or report; 950692 CosmicAntiNuclei - antideuteron/antinuclei production in collisions; 716651 NEDM - neutron electric dipole moment; 670168 NEWPHYS-MOLECULES - H2/D2/HD precision frequency measurements; 947696 YbFUN - atomic parity violation in ytterbium; 805065 HydMet - hydrogen in structural metals; 948240 UniRand - ultracold lithium optical lattice; 660083 MEMDYN, 724932 MECHANICS, 101023589 CLAVHUB, 843554 BIOMOSAIC, 864792 OXYGEN, 863490 GyroSCoPe, 101037319-class off-topic best chunks (biology, materials, geoscience) - all clearly off-topic from their best chunk. XUV-COMB is OUT: its objective names anti-hydrogen only as a foil ('Besides anti-hydrogen, high resolution laser spectroscopy of singly ionized helium is the next logical item on the list') and the project is He+ XUV spectroscopy. (b) project.objective ILIKE '%antiproton%' OR '%antimatter%' OR '%antiprotonic%' -> 42 projects; the antimatter-adjacent ones that could plausibly involve anti-atoms were read (PUMA 726276 antiproton-nucleus annihilation for neutron halos; STEP 852818; FunI 832848) and none works with antihydrogen. term_style exact-term: 'antihydrogen' appears verbatim in all three gold objectives and QUARTET uses 'anti-atoms'; the rank matrix agrees - lexical ranks ANGRAM 2 and QUARTET 3 on the question text, so real term overlap exists (AVA is dense 7 / hybrid 4 / hybrid_rerank 3, which does not contradict the style).

evidence:
Gold, quoted verbatim from the passages that satisfy the question.

748826 ANGRAM - "Antimatter gravity measurement: How does antihydrogen fall?"
- objective: "The only stable, neutral antimatter atom available for laboratory study is the antihydrogen. We here propose to carry out a 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration for antihydrogen, which will reveal the sign of gravity acting on antimatter, within the next two years. The principle is based on the rotation of a three grating moire deflectometer, coupled to a detector, and requires neither position resolution nor time-of-flight information for the through-going antihydrogen atoms."
- report/workPerformed: "1) Production of antihydrogen in the AEgIS apparatus, by three-body recombination of antiprotons and positrons, 2)Development of moire deflectometer and detection system and 3)Data taking for the gravity measurement." ... "The crucial finding was that the Rydberg state antihydrogen interacts heavily with the atoms from the gratings, and the study led to the conclusion that material gratings could not be used to measure the vertical deflection of Rydberg state antihydrogen in Earth's gravitational field. Therefore, the gratings were finally not produced" ... "a dedicated physics study measuring antiproton-nucleus annihilation at rest and comparing it with the current simulation models (GEANT4, FLUKA)".

101019414 QUARTET - "Precision measurments of quantum transitions in exotic atoms"
- objective: "QUARTET - Quantum transitions in exotic atoms, will pursue both directions through two complementary experimental campaigns:1. Muonium spectroscopy using the most intense low-energy muon beam at PSI.2. Antihydrogen spectroscopy using the most intense low-energy proton beam at the ELENA beamline at CERN.QUARTET will focus on transitions in the microwave region of the electromagnetic spectrum, namely the classical Lamb-Shift, which for Antihydrogen has an added value: If no difference between matter and its counterpart is observed, this measurement will provide the first determination of the antiproton charge radius."
- report/workPerformed: "The main research and development performed in this work were the design optimization and implementation of microwave spectroscopy setups for muonium and antihydrogen." ... "I have adapted the setup to fit the GBAR beamline at CERN."

721559 AVA - "Accelerators Validating Antimatter physics"
- objective: "Antiprotons, stored and cooled at low energies in a storage ring or at rest in traps, are highly desirable for the investigation of basic questions on fundamental interactions, the static structure of antiprotonic atoms, CPT tests by high-resolution spectroscopy on antihydrogen, as well as gravity experiments." ... "The Extra Low Energy Antiproton ring (ELENA) will be a critical upgrade to this unique facility" ... "advances are urgently required in numerical tools that can adequately model beam transport, life time and interaction, beam diagnostics tools and detectors that can fully characterize the beam's properties" ... "AVA is a new European training network ... for a cohort of 15 Fellows."
- report/workPerformed: three work packages named "Facility Design and Optimization", "Beam Diagnostics", "Antimatter Experiments, including experiments into the effects of gravity on antimatter and spectroscopic measurements that give an insight into the structure of antiparticles."

Discrimination counter-examples (adjudicated OUT, quoted):
- 742247 XUV-COMB, objective: "Besides anti-hydrogen, high resolution laser spectroscopy of singly ionized helium is the next logical item on the list." The project is He+ 1S-2S XUV frequency-comb spectroscopy; antihydrogen is named only as the alternative not taken.
- 804383 ANTI-ATOM, report/summary: "positronium (Ps, an electron-positron pair) and antihydrogen (a proton-antiproton pair), are under intensive study at international laboratories to test fundamental laws of nature." Its own programme is many-body theory of low-energy positron and Ps interactions with normal matter.
- 852818 STEP, objective: "I propose to extend the methods in low-energy antiproton precision measurements by developing a transportable antiproton reservoir" - single antiprotons in a Penning trap, no anti-atom.
- 832848 FunI, objective: "the most stringent CPT test in the baryonic sector by comparing the magnetic moments of the proton and the antiproton" - no antihydrogen.
- 726276 PUMA, objective: "the interaction of antiprotons with unstable nuclei" for neutron halos and skins - no antihydrogen.

record.text: Which project is commercialising a drive-by-wire system for the steer, brake and gas functions of a production car so that people with a wide range of physical disabilities can drive using joysticks or handlebars instead of conventional controls, with the same modular system also serving teleoperated and autonomous off-highway vehicles?
record.reference_answer: Joysteer 3.0. The project is bringing to market a modular drive-by-wire system covering the steer, brake and gas functions of a vehicle: electronic driving systems plus individually adapted man-machine interfaces such as joysticks or handlebars take the place of the conventional controls, so that people with a wide range of disabilities can drive an adapted standard production car with fast, redundant and predictable response. The same modular architecture, extended with remote GPS-based access, is aimed at teleoperated and autonomous vehicles that remove workers from risky off-highway settings such as construction, mining, agriculture-forestry, airport handling and rescue.

record.text: Which project is commercialising a drive-by-wire system for the steer, brake and gas functions of a production car so that people with a wide range of physical disabilities can drive using joysticks or handlebars instead of conventional controls, with the same modular system also serving teleoperated and autonomous off-highway vehicles?
record.reference_answer: Joysteer 3.0. The project is bringing to market a modular drive-by-wire system covering the steer, brake and gas functions of a vehicle: electronic driving systems plus individually adapted man-machine interfaces such as joysticks or handlebars take the place of the conventional controls, so that people with a wide range of disabilities can drive an adapted standard production car with fast, redundant and predictable response. The same modular architecture, extended with remote GPS-based access, is aimed at teleoperated and autonomous vehicles that remove workers from risky off-highway settings such as construction, mining, agriculture-forestry, airport handling and rescue.

record.text: How do EU-funded projects whose work centres on antihydrogen differ in what each one sets out to do with it - which property of the anti-atom it aims to measure and by what apparatus, or, if it measures none itself, what it instead builds for the experiments that do?
record.reference_answer: Three projects centre on antihydrogen and they take on different pieces of it. ANGRAM proposed a 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration of antihydrogen - enough to reveal the sign of gravity acting on antimatter and test the Weak Equivalence Principle - using a rotating three-grating moire deflectometer that needs neither position resolution nor time-of-flight, with the atoms made in the AEgIS apparatus by three-body recombination of antiprotons and positrons; it reported that Rydberg-state antihydrogen interacts too heavily with the atoms of material gratings, so the gratings were never produced and the work shifted to antiproton annihilation-at-rest measurements compared against GEANT4 and FLUKA. QUARTET measures a spectroscopic property instead: the classical Lamb shift in the microwave region, pursued for antihydrogen on the ELENA beamline at CERN alongside a parallel muonium campaign at PSI, where agreement with matter would give the first determination of the antiproton charge radius; its setup was commissioned with protons and then adapted to the GBAR beamline. AVA measures no antihydrogen property itself - it is a training network for 15 Fellows whose three work packages (facility design and optimization around the ELENA upgrade to CERN's Antiproton Decelerator, beam diagnostics, and antimatter experiments) build the simulation codes, prototype detectors and beam quality that CPT tests by high-resolution spectroscopy on antihydrogen and antimatter gravity experiments depend on.

All three read in full via get_project_text before the question existed. Pooled search on the final question text, k=10, all four conditions, 20 distinct projects. IN: 748826 ANGRAM (objective: 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration for antihydrogen with a rotating three-grating moire deflectometer); 101019414 QUARTET (objective: Antihydrogen spectroscopy on the ELENA beamline, classical Lamb-Shift, antiproton charge radius); 721559 AVA (objective: CPT tests by high-resolution spectroscopy on antihydrogen and gravity experiments as the physics its ELENA-era accelerator, diagnostics and simulation R&D serves; report work packages Facility Design, Beam Diagnostics, Antimatter Experiments). OUT with reason: 804383 ANTI-ATOM - positron/positronium many-body theory, antihydrogen named once in the report summary as background on what other laboratories study, no antihydrogen work of its own; 852818 STEP - portable antiproton reservoir, Penning-trap CPT and cyclotron-frequency measurements on single antiprotons, no antihydrogen; 832848 FunI - Penning-trap magnetic moments and masses of (anti)protons and highly charged ions, no antihydrogen; 818053 Mu-MASS - muonium laser spectroscopy, no antihydrogen in objective or report; 950692 CosmicAntiNuclei - antideuteron/antinuclei production in collisions; 716651 NEDM - neutron electric dipole moment; 670168 NEWPHYS-MOLECULES - H2/D2/HD precision frequency measurements; 947696 YbFUN - atomic parity violation in ytterbium; 805065 HydMet - hydrogen in structural metals; 948240 UniRand - ultracold lithium optical lattice; 660083 MEMDYN, 724932 MECHANICS, 101023589 CLAVHUB, 843554 BIOMOSAIC, 864792 OXYGEN, 863490 GyroSCoPe, 101037319-class off-topic best chunks (biology, materials, geoscience) - all clearly off-topic from their best chunk. evidence:
Gold, quoted verbatim from the passages that satisfy the question.

748826 ANGRAM - "Antimatter gravity measurement: How does antihydrogen fall?"
- objective: "The only stable, neutral antimatter atom available for laboratory study is the antihydrogen. We here propose to carry out a 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration for antihydrogen, which will reveal the sign of gravity acting on antimatter, within the next two years. The principle is based on the rotation of a three grating moire deflectometer, coupled to a detector, and requires neither position resolution nor time-of-flight information for the through-going antihydrogen atoms."
- report/workPerformed: "1) Production of antihydrogen in the AEgIS apparatus, by three-body recombination of antiprotons and positrons, 2)Development of moire deflectometer and detection system and 3)Data taking for the gravity measurement." ... "The crucial finding was that the Rydberg state antihydrogen interacts heavily with the atoms from the gratings, and the study led to the conclusion that material gratings could not be used to measure the vertical deflection of Rydberg state antihydrogen in Earth's gravitational field. Therefore, the gratings were finally not produced" ... "a dedicated physics study measuring antiproton-nucleus annihilation at rest and comparing it with the current simulation models (GEANT4, FLUKA)".

101019414 QUARTET - "Precision measurments of quantum transitions in exotic atoms"
- objective: "QUARTET - Quantum transitions in exotic atoms, will pursue both directions through two complementary experimental campaigns:1. Muonium spectroscopy using the most intense low-energy muon beam at PSI.2. Antihydrogen spectroscopy using the most intense low-energy proton beam at the ELENA beamline at CERN.QUARTET will focus on transitions in the microwave region of the electromagnetic spectrum, namely the classical Lamb-Shift, which for Antihydrogen has an added value: If no difference between matter and its counterpart is observed, this measurement will provide the first determination of the antiproton charge radius."
- report/workPerformed: "The main research and development performed in this work were the design optimization and implementation of microwave spectroscopy setups for muonium and antihydrogen." ... "I have adapted the setup to fit the GBAR beamline at CERN."

721559 AVA - "Accelerators Validating Antimatter physics"
- objective: "Antiprotons, stored and cooled at low energies in a storage ring or at rest in traps, are highly desirable for the investigation of basic questions on fundamental interactions, the static structure of antiprotonic atoms, CPT tests by high-resolution spectroscopy on antihydrogen, as well as gravity experiments." ... "The Extra Low Energy Antiproton ring (ELENA) will be a critical upgrade to this unique facility" ... "advances are urgently required in numerical tools that can adequately model beam transport, life time and interaction, beam diagnostics tools and detectors that can fully characterize the beam's properties" ... "AVA is a new European training network ... for a cohort of 15 Fellows."
- report/workPerformed: three work packages named "Facility Design and Optimization", "Beam Diagnostics", "Antimatter Experiments, including experiments into the effects of gravity on antimatter and spectroscopic measurements that give an insight into the structure of antiparticles."

Discrimination counter-examples (adjudicated OUT, quoted):
- 742247 XUV-COMB, objective: "Besides anti-hydrogen, high resolution laser spectroscopy of singly ionized helium is the next logical item on the list." The project is He+ 1S-2S XUV frequency-comb spectroscopy; antihydrogen is named only as the alternative not taken.
- 804383 ANTI-ATOM, report/summary: "positronium (Ps, an electron-positron pair) and antihydrogen (a proton-antiproton pair), are under intensive study at international laboratories to test fundamental laws of nature." Its own programme is many-body theory of low-energy positron and Ps interactions with normal matter.
- 852818 STEP, objective: "I propose to extend the methods in low-energy antiproton precision measurements by developing a transportable antiproton reservoir" - single antiprotons in a Penning trap, no anti-atom.
- 832848 FunI, objective: "the most stringent CPT test in the baryonic sector by comparing the magnetic moments of the proton and the antiproton" - no antihydrogen.
- 726276 PUMA, objective: "the interaction of antiprotons with unstable nuclei" for neutron halos and skins - no antihydrogen.

record.text: How do EU-funded projects whose work centres on antihydrogen differ in what each one sets out to do with it - which property of the anti-atom it aims to measure and by what apparatus, or, if it measures none itself, what it instead builds for the experiments that do?
record.reference_answer: Three projects centre on antihydrogen and they take on different pieces of it. ANGRAM proposed a 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration of antihydrogen - enough to reveal the sign of gravity acting on antimatter and test the Weak Equivalence Principle - using a rotating three-grating moire deflectometer that needs neither position resolution nor time-of-flight, with the atoms made in the AEgIS apparatus by three-body recombination of antiprotons and positrons; it reported that Rydberg-state antihydrogen interacts too heavily with the atoms of material gratings, so the gratings were never produced and the work shifted to antiproton annihilation-at-rest measurements compared against GEANT4 and FLUKA. QUARTET measures a spectroscopic property instead: the classical Lamb shift in the microwave region, pursued for antihydrogen on the ELENA beamline at CERN alongside a parallel muonium campaign at PSI, where agreement with matter would give the first determination of the antiproton charge radius; its setup was commissioned with protons and then adapted to the GBAR beamline. AVA measures no antihydrogen property itself - it is a training network for 15 Fellows whose three work packages (facility design and optimization around the ELENA upgrade to CERN's Antiproton Decelerator, beam diagnostics, and antimatter experiments) build the simulation codes, prototype detectors and beam quality that CPT tests by high-resolution spectroscopy on antihydrogen and antimatter gravity experiments depend on.

All three read in full via get_project_text before the question existed. Pooled search on the final question text, k=10, all four conditions, 20 distinct projects. evidence:
Gold, quoted verbatim from the passages that satisfy the question.

748826 ANGRAM - "Antimatter gravity measurement: How does antihydrogen fall?"
- objective: "The only stable, neutral antimatter atom available for laboratory study is the antihydrogen. We here propose to carry out a 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration for antihydrogen, which will reveal the sign of gravity acting on antimatter, within the next two years. The principle is based on the rotation of a three grating moire deflectometer, coupled to a detector, and requires neither position resolution nor time-of-flight information for the through-going antihydrogen atoms."
- report/workPerformed: "1) Production of antihydrogen in the AEgIS apparatus, by three-body recombination of antiprotons and positrons, 2)Development of moire deflectometer and detection system and 3)Data taking for the gravity measurement." ... "The crucial finding was that the Rydberg state antihydrogen interacts heavily with the atoms from the gratings, and the study led to the conclusion that material gratings could not be used to measure the vertical deflection of Rydberg state antihydrogen in Earth's gravitational field. Therefore, the gratings were finally not produced" ... "a dedicated physics study measuring antiproton-nucleus annihilation at rest and comparing it with the current simulation models (GEANT4, FLUKA)".

101019414 QUARTET - "Precision measurments of quantum transitions in exotic atoms"
- objective: "QUARTET - Quantum transitions in exotic atoms, will pursue both directions through two complementary experimental campaigns:1. Muonium spectroscopy using the most intense low-energy muon beam at PSI.2. Antihydrogen spectroscopy using the most intense low-energy proton beam at the ELENA beamline at CERN.QUARTET will focus on transitions in the microwave region of the electromagnetic spectrum, namely the classical Lamb-Shift, which for Antihydrogen has an added value: If no difference between matter and its counterpart is observed, this measurement will provide the first determination of the antiproton charge radius."
- report/workPerformed: "The main research and development performed in this work were the design optimization and implementation of microwave spectroscopy setups for muonium and antihydrogen." ... "I have adapted the setup to fit the GBAR beamline at CERN."

721559 AVA - "Accelerators Validating Antimatter physics"
- objective: "Antiprotons, stored and cooled at low energies in a storage ring or at rest in traps, are highly desirable for the investigation of basic questions on fundamental interactions, the static structure of antiprotonic atoms, CPT tests by high-resolution spectroscopy on antihydrogen, as well as gravity experiments." ... "The Extra Low Energy Antiproton ring (ELENA) will be a critical upgrade to this unique facility" ... "advances are urgently required in numerical tools that can adequately model beam transport, life time and interaction, beam diagnostics tools and detectors that can fully characterize the beam's properties" ... "AVA is a new European training network ... for a cohort of 15 Fellows."
- report/workPerformed: three work packages named "Facility Design and Optimization", "Beam Diagnostics", "Antimatter Experiments, including experiments into the effects of gravity on antimatter and spectroscopic measurements that give an insight into the structure of antiparticles."

- 742247 XUV-COMB, objective: "Besides anti-hydrogen, high resolution laser spectroscopy of singly ionized helium is the next logical item on the list." The project is He+ 1S-2S XUV frequency-comb spectroscopy; antihydrogen is named only as the alternative not taken.
- 804383 ANTI-ATOM, report/summary: "positronium (Ps, an electron-positron pair) and antihydrogen (a proton-antiproton pair), are under intensive study at international laboratories to test fundamental laws of nature." record.text: Which EU-funded projects are working on processing the slurry and droppings that pile up on livestock farms into a concentrated, storable product that farmers can spread on their crops instead of shop-bought mineral fertiliser?
record.reference_answer: Fourteen projects in the corpus set out to turn livestock manure into a made fertilising product rather than leaving it to be spread raw. One group is on-farm equipment from SMEs: ENFIR dehydrates manure with far-infrared heat into pelletized compost and organic fertilizer, producing more than 1.500 ton/year per unit; UltraBio applies ultrasound to manure and digestate so that the nutrient-enriched solid fraction can be pelletised and sold as a storable organic fertiliser; VALI burns manure on small farms for heat and electricity and leaves compact, easy-to-transport ashes directly usable as dry fertilizer; and DEPURGAN treats pig slurry at its origin in an electrocoagulation reactor, yielding a solid fraction with calorific value plus an NPK liquid effluent. Two projects use plasma to fix nitrogen from air into slurry or biogas digestate on the farm as an alternative to chemical fertiliser - Sustainable Manure and SmartNitroFarm, both involving N2 Applied - while AMBIENCE captures 70-80% of the ammonia from animal waste, pig farms and biogas digestate as ammonium sulphate for fertiliser manufacturers. The larger research and demonstration actions work along the whole value chain: FERTIMANURE runs five on-farm nutrient recovery pilots and targets 31 marketable end-products (11 bio-based and 20 tailor-made fertilisers); SYSTEMIC processes digestate of pig manure into a mineral N fertiliser, an organic soil improver and a P fertiliser at demonstration plants such as Groot Zevert Vergisting; NewFert converts ashes of different origins and livestock effluents into a new generation of fertilisers; and B-FERST builds 8 specialised fertilising products from streams that include livestock manure compost. Poul-AR (poultry manure converted to an ammonium salt directly applicable as fertilizer), IMBIO (patented processing of animal waste including chicken manure into high-quality organic fertilizers) and SUSTAINABLEFARM (a modular waste-to-energy platform giving biogas plus organic fertilizers) complete the set.

record.text: How do EU-funded projects that set out to measure a property of the antihydrogen atom itself differ in which property each aims to measure and by what apparatus?
record.reference_answer: Two projects set out to measure a property of antihydrogen itself, and they target different properties with different apparatus. ANGRAM aimed at a 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration for antihydrogen - enough to reveal the sign of gravity acting on antimatter and test the Weak Equivalence Principle - by rotating a three-grating moire deflectometer coupled to a detector, a scheme that requires neither position resolution nor time-of-flight information; the atoms were to be made in the AEgIS apparatus by three-body recombination of antiprotons and positrons, but only a signal consistent with production of antihydrogen atoms was reported, after the end of the beam time, so the gravity measurement could not be carried out, and the project further found that Rydberg-state antihydrogen interacts too heavily with the atoms of material gratings for material gratings to be usable. QUARTET measures a spectroscopic property instead: the classical Lamb shift, a transition in the microwave region, with antihydrogen spectroscopy planned on the ELENA beamline at CERN alongside a parallel muonium campaign at PSI; if no difference from matter is observed the measurement gives the first determination of the antiproton charge radius. Their apparatus differs accordingly - a rotating grating interferometer and annihilation detector for the free-fall measurement in ANGRAM, a microwave spectroscopy setup commissioned with protons and then adapted to the GBAR beamline for QUARTET.

record.text: How do EU-funded projects that set out to measure a property of the antihydrogen atom itself differ in which property each aims to measure and by what apparatus?
record.reference_answer: Two projects set out to measure a property of antihydrogen itself, and they target different properties with different apparatus. ANGRAM aimed at a 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration for antihydrogen - enough to reveal the sign of gravity acting on antimatter and test the Weak Equivalence Principle - by rotating a three-grating moire deflectometer coupled to a detector, a scheme that requires neither position resolution nor time-of-flight information; the atoms were to be made in the AEgIS apparatus by three-body recombination of antiprotons and positrons, but only a signal consistent with production of antihydrogen atoms was reported, after the end of the beam time, so the gravity measurement could not be carried out, and the project further found that Rydberg-state antihydrogen interacts too heavily with the atoms of material gratings for material gratings to be usable. QUARTET measures a spectroscopic property instead: the classical Lamb shift, a transition in the microwave region, with antihydrogen spectroscopy planned on the ELENA beamline at CERN alongside a parallel muonium campaign at PSI; if no difference from matter is observed the measurement gives the first determination of the antiproton charge radius. Their apparatus differs accordingly - a rotating grating interferometer and annihilation detector for the free-fall measurement in ANGRAM, a microwave spectroscopy setup commissioned with protons and then adapted to the GBAR beamline for QUARTET.

record.text: How do EU-funded projects that set out to measure a property of the antihydrogen atom itself differ in which property each aims to measure and by what apparatus?
record.reference_answer: Two projects set out to measure a property of antihydrogen itself, and they target different properties with different apparatus. ANGRAM aimed at a 30% measurement of the gravitational acceleration for antihydrogen - enough to reveal the sign of gravity acting on antimatter and test the Weak Equivalence Principle - by rotating a three-grating moire deflectometer coupled to a detector, a scheme that requires neither position resolution nor time-of-flight information; the atoms were to be made in the AEgIS apparatus by three-body recombination of antiprotons and positrons, but only a signal consistent with production of antihydrogen atoms was reported, after the end of the beam time, so the gravity measurement could not be carried out, and the project further found that Rydberg-state antihydrogen interacts too heavily with the atoms of material gratings for material gratings to be usable. QUARTET measures a spectroscopic property instead: the classical Lamb shift, a transition in the microwave region, with antihydrogen spectroscopy planned on the ELENA beamline at CERN alongside a parallel muonium campaign at PSI; if no difference from matter is observed the measurement gives the first determination of the antiproton charge radius. Their apparatus differs accordingly - a rotating grating interferometer and annihilation detector for the free-fall measurement in ANGRAM, a microwave spectroscopy setup commissioned with protons and then adapted to the GBAR beamline for QUARTET.

findings.claim: The membership clause 'concentrated, storable product' does not separate the gold members from two of the recorded exclusions. Sustainable Manure (965546) and SmartNitroFarm (101008819) do not concentrate anything - they add nitrogen to slurry that stays slurry - which is the same shape as GasAbate N+ and Treat2ReUse, both excluded under criterion (c). A reader taking the phrase literally drops the two plasma projects (gold 14 -> 12); a reader taking it as 'any upgraded fertilising product' adds the two excluded ones (14 -> 16).
findings.evidence: get_project_text 101008819 objective: 'uses plasma technology to increase the nutrient content in manure'; report summary: 'It is installed on farms and turns liquid manure into sustainable fertiliser using just air and electricity. The end-product is called NEO fertiliser.' get_project_text 965546 objective: 'upgrading livestock manure to an improved fertiliser... removing odour, giving the farmer flexibility in spreading, optimising the fertilising effect of manure'. Neither text claims volume reduction, drying, pelletising or a separated product; the material spread is still the farm's own slurry. Against that, the recorded exclusion of GasAbate N+ rests on it being an in-situ treatment that raises manure's fertiliser value ('farmers purchasing approximately 30% less mineral fertiliser', report summary, retrieved this session at lexical rank 2 on the critic's reformulation), and Treat2ReUse on acidification 'improving the fertiliser value of products'. The three interventions differ in chemistry, not in whether a concentrated separate product results.
findings.fix_direction: Replace the 'concentrated, storable product' clause with the distinction that actually holds across the recorded adjudications - a product physically separated from the manure stream (pellets, ash, ammonium salt, struvite, dried solids, mineral N fertiliser) rather than manure treated in place. That wording drops the two plasma projects out of gold (12 remains L3) and keeps the additive/acidification exclusions honest. The alternative - keeping the plasma pair - requires wording that admits in-place upgrading, and then GasAbate N+ and Treat2ReUse have to be re-adjudicated.

record.text: Which EU-funded projects are working on processing the slurry and droppings that pile up on livestock farms into a concentrated, storable product that farmers can spread on their crops instead of shop-bought mineral fertiliser?
record.reference_answer: Fourteen projects in the corpus set out to turn livestock manure into a made fertilising product rather than leaving it to be spread raw. One group is on-farm equipment from SMEs: ENFIR dehydrates manure with far-infrared heat into pelletized compost and organic fertilizer, producing more than 1.500 ton/year per unit; UltraBio applies ultrasound to manure and digestate so that the nutrient-enriched solid fraction can be pelletised and sold as a storable organic fertiliser; VALI burns manure on small farms for heat and electricity and leaves compact, easy-to-transport ashes directly usable as dry fertilizer; and DEPURGAN treats pig slurry at its origin in an electrocoagulation reactor, yielding a solid fraction with calorific value plus an NPK liquid effluent. Two projects use plasma to fix nitrogen from air into slurry or biogas digestate on the farm as an alternative to chemical fertiliser - Sustainable Manure and SmartNitroFarm, both involving N2 Applied - while AMBIENCE captures 70-80% of the ammonia from animal waste, pig farms and biogas digestate as ammonium sulphate for fertiliser manufacturers. The larger research and demonstration actions work along the whole value chain: FERTIMANURE runs five on-farm nutrient recovery pilots and targets 31 marketable end-products (11 bio-based and 20 tailor-made fertilisers); SYSTEMIC processes digestate of pig manure into a mineral N fertiliser, an organic soil improver and a P fertiliser at demonstration plants such as Groot Zevert Vergisting; NewFert converts ashes of different origins and livestock effluents into a new generation of fertilisers; and B-FERST builds 8 specialised fertilising products from streams that include livestock manure compost. Poul-AR (poultry manure converted to an ammonium salt directly applicable as fertilizer), IMBIO (patented processing of animal waste including chicken manure into high-quality organic fertilizers) and SUSTAINABLEFARM (a modular waste-to-energy platform giving biogas plus organic fertilizers) complete the set.

The scope was therefore tightened to the livestock-manure branch, which is enumerable and decidable. MEMBERSHIP RULE (one reading): a project is IN iff (a) its text names livestock manure, slurry, litter or the digestate/ash derived from it among the streams it processes, AND (b) producing a fertilising product for crops is a stated project objective, AND (c) that product is a processed/concentrated form - not raw manure spread as-is and not an additive that leaves the manure raw. OUT 793325 Green-DROP (precision irrigation/fertigation equipment - applies farm wastes, manufactures no product); OUT 101010197 GasAbate N-plus (powdered additive to stored manure - fails (c), manure stays manure); OUT 795974 Treat2ReUse (manure acidification to cut ammonia emissions and improve fertiliser value - fails (c), the output is treated slurry, not a concentrated product); OUT 652654 OK-Net Arable (organic-farming knowledge network); OUT 818309 LEX4BIO (knowledge base, toolkit and legislative framework for bio-based fertilisers - fails (b), produces no product); OUT 814258 REFLOW (P recovery for fertilisers from dairy PROCESSING waste water - fails (a), not livestock manure); OUT 774340 Organic-PLUS (phasing out contentious organic-farming inputs); OUT 691404 biowave (microwave pre-treatment of pig manure for biogas yield - fails (b), energy only); OUT 792021 SUSFERT (struvite from wastewater, not manure - fails (a)); OUT 719462 and 765262 MobiLab (soil nutrient sensor). New INs beyond the pool: 652171 Poul-AR, 668128 NewFert, 763185 ENFIR (far-infrared dehydration of manure into pelletized organic fertilizer), 807017 IMBIO (animal waste incl. chicken manure into organic fertilizers), 827586 AMBIENCE (ammonia from animal waste/pig farms/digestate captured as ammonium sulphate for fertiliser manufacturers), 867622 VALI (manure combustion, ashes directly usable as dry fertilizer). OUT from sweep 1: 652017 BIOFERLUDAN, 854814 ADFU, 863000 NOMAD (all treat generic biogas digestate; none names livestock manure as an input - fails (a)); 691911 Record Biomap (biomethane research coordination); 727874 SABANA (microalgae biorefinery; pig manure is one nutrient medium for algae, the products are algal biostimulants/feed - fails (c)); 750104 RESOURCE (groundwater pollution and antibiotic resistance study); 751052 VegWaMus CirCrop (food-waste digestate as mushroom/vegetable substrate); 794823 MapDung (archaeology of dung as construction material); 796830 Target-N2O (emission modelling); 818413 NextGenRoadFuels (transport fuels); 820352 Smartmushroom (processes spent mushroom substrate, not manure - fails (a)); 825325 SARMENTI (sensor); 837750 FARMYNG (mealworm protein; the recovered manure is insect frass and a side stream). SWEEP 2 (catches fertiliser-products worded without the word fertiliser): manure/slurry/animal waste/excreta/dung terms AND (soil improver|soil amendment|pelleti|ammonium sulphate|struvite|compost|nutrient recovery|recovered nutrient|euroSciVoc title ILIKE fertili) AND NOT fertilis/fertiliz -> 4 projects, all OUT: 662476 Mubic (mushroom growth substrate), 817696 BEST4SOIL (soil-health knowledge network), 849841 REBOOT (P recovered from wet waste into fuels and carbon materials), 898560 ALGALVANISE (algal functional ingredients from digestate). TERM_STYLE: paraphrase. The question uses none of the specialist labels the gold texts name this topic by - 'nutrient recovery', 'valorisation', 'bio-based fertiliser', 'struvite', 'digestate', 'circular economy' - and does not use the word 'manure' at all, saying 'the slurry and droppings that pile up on livestock farms'. It does share the plain words 'slurry', 'livestock' and 'mineral fertiliser' with several gold texts, which is why part of the gold is lexical-reachable (FERTIMANURE lexical 5, B-FERST lexical 7, SmartNitroFarm lexical 8, Sustainable Manure lexical 2) while other gold is dense/rerank-only (SYSTEMIC dense 2 hybrid 7, UltraBio dense 10, SUSTAINABLEFARM dense 7 hybrid 6 rerank 5, no lexical rank for any of the three). SEED RETRIEVAL: 862849 FERTIMANURE appears in all four conditions on the final wording (lexical 5, dense 3, hybrid 2, rerank 6). Seeds 652171 Poul-AR and 668128 NewFert do not appear in the final k=10 union, though both ranked inside earlier wordings of the same question this session (Poul-AR lexical 5 / hybrid 8; NewFert dense 5 / hybrid 6, and dense 8 on the broader wording); with 14 gold projects a k=10 pool cannot show them all. Both are unambiguously IN by their own text and stay in gold. BOUNDARY CALLS the reviewer should look at: Treat2ReUse (795974) and GasAbate N+ (101010197) are manure-upgrading projects excluded by criterion (c); SABANA (727874) names pig manure but makes algal products; LEX4BIO (818309) and NUTRIMAN (818470) are about recovered-nutrient fertilisers but manufacture nothing.

Sustainable Manure (965546) and SmartNitroFarm (101008819) do not concentrate anything - they add nitrogen to slurry that stays slurry - which is the same shape as GasAbate N+ and Treat2ReUse, both excluded under criterion (c). The end-product is called NEO fertiliser.' get_project_text 965546 objective: 'upgrading livestock manure to an improved fertiliser... removing odour, giving the farmer flexibility in spreading, optimising the fertilising effect of manure'. record.text: Which EU-funded projects are working on processing the slurry and droppings that pile up on livestock farms into a concentrated, storable product that farmers can spread on their crops instead of shop-bought mineral fertiliser?
record.reference_answer: Fourteen projects in the corpus set out to turn livestock manure into a made fertilising product rather than leaving it to be spread raw. One group is on-farm equipment from SMEs: ENFIR dehydrates manure with far-infrared heat into pelletized compost and organic fertilizer, producing more than 1.500 ton/year per unit; UltraBio applies ultrasound to manure and digestate so that the nutrient-enriched solid fraction can be pelletised and sold as a storable organic fertiliser; VALI burns manure on small farms for heat and electricity and leaves compact, easy-to-transport ashes directly usable as dry fertilizer; and DEPURGAN treats pig slurry at its origin in an electrocoagulation reactor, yielding a solid fraction with calorific value plus an NPK liquid effluent. Two projects use plasma to fix nitrogen from air into slurry or biogas digestate on the farm as an alternative to chemical fertiliser - Sustainable Manure and SmartNitroFarm, both involving N2 Applied - while AMBIENCE captures 70-80% of the ammonia from animal waste, pig farms and biogas digestate as ammonium sulphate for fertiliser manufacturers. The larger research and demonstration actions work along the whole value chain: FERTIMANURE runs five on-farm nutrient recovery pilots and targets 31 marketable end-products (11 bio-based and 20 tailor-made fertilisers); SYSTEMIC processes digestate of pig manure into a mineral N fertiliser, an organic soil improver and a P fertiliser at demonstration plants such as Groot Zevert Vergisting; NewFert converts ashes of different origins and livestock effluents into a new generation of fertilisers; and B-FERST builds 8 specialised fertilising products from streams that include livestock manure compost. Poul-AR (poultry manure converted to an ammonium salt directly applicable as fertilizer), IMBIO (patented processing of animal waste including chicken manure into high-quality organic fertilizers) and SUSTAINABLEFARM (a modular waste-to-energy platform giving biogas plus organic fertilizers) complete the set.
record.notes: SEEDS: taken from corpus-profile candidate vector-63 (sample_ids) - 652171 Poul-AR, 668128 NewFert, 862849 FERTIMANURE, read in full before the question existed. Candidate drift check re-executed this session: the candidate's evidence SQL (objective/title ILIKE struvite OR phosphorus recovery OR nutrient recovery) still returns exactly 21 projects with the recorded ids. SCOPE TIGHTENING: the candidate's 21-project theme (nutrient recovery from any waste stream) proved too broad to enumerate honestly - a fertiliser-from-waste recall net (objective ILIKE fertilis/fertiliz AND any of sewage/sludge/manure/slurry/digestate/biowaste/urine/wastewater) returns 60 projects, and the municipal-wastewater sub-branch alone returns 36 with several undecidable by-product cases (HTCycle, KATEDRAL, WAS2VAL, FlashPhos name fertiliser only as one possible downstream use). The scope was therefore tightened to the livestock-manure branch, which is enumerable and decidable. MEMBERSHIP RULE (one reading): a project is IN iff (a) its text names livestock manure, slurry, litter or the digestate/ash derived from it among the streams it processes, AND (b) producing a fertilising product for crops is a stated project objective, AND (c) that product is a processed/concentrated form - not raw manure spread as-is and not an additive that leaves the manure raw. POOLED ADJUDICATIONS (final wording, k=10, union 19): IN 673771 DEPURGAN (electrocoagulation of pig slurry; 'valorizes the manure (energy recovery and fertilizer)', NPK liquid effluent ready to be used); IN 965546 Sustainable Manure (plasma upgrading of slurry/digestate to an improved fertiliser, 'cost-effective alternative to chemical fertiliser'); IN 862849 FERTIMANURE (31 marketable fertiliser end-products from manure); IN 730400 SYSTEMIC (digestate of pig manure into mineral N fertiliser, soil improver, P fertiliser); IN 957068 SUSTAINABLEFARM (manure to biogas plus organic fertilizers with the right nutritional properties); IN 837583 B-FERST (8 specialised fertilisers from streams including manure-livestock compost); IN 101008819 SmartNitroFarm (local fertiliser production from slurry/digestate by plasma); IN 761513 UltraBio (manure/digestate separated, nutrient-enriched solid pelletised and sold as storable organic fertiliser). findings.claim: The membership clause 'concentrated, storable product' does not separate the gold members from two of the recorded exclusions. Sustainable Manure (965546) and SmartNitroFarm (101008819) do not concentrate anything - they add nitrogen to slurry that stays slurry - which is the same shape as GasAbate N+ and Treat2ReUse, both excluded under criterion (c). A reader taking the phrase literally drops the two plasma projects (gold 14 -> 12); a reader taking it as 'any upgraded fertilising product' adds the two excluded ones (14 -> 16).
findings.evidence: get_project_text 101008819 objective: 'uses plasma technology to increase the nutrient content in manure'; report summary: 'It is installed on farms and turns liquid manure into sustainable fertiliser using just air and electricity. The end-product is called NEO fertiliser.' get_project_text 965546 objective: 'upgrading livestock manure to an improved fertiliser... removing odour, giving the farmer flexibility in spreading, optimising the fertilising effect of manure'. Neither text claims volume reduction, drying, pelletising or a separated product; the material spread is still the farm's own slurry. Against that, the recorded exclusion of GasAbate N+ rests on it being an in-situ treatment that raises manure's fertiliser value ('farmers purchasing approximately 30% less mineral fertiliser', report summary, retrieved this session at lexical rank 2 on the critic's reformulation), and Treat2ReUse on acidification 'improving the fertiliser value of products'. The three interventions differ in chemistry, not in whether a concentrated separate product results.
findings.fix_direction: Replace the 'concentrated, storable product' clause with the distinction that actually holds across the recorded adjudications - a product physically separated from the manure stream (pellets, ash, ammonium salt, struvite, dried solids, mineral N fertiliser) rather than manure treated in place. That wording drops the two plasma projects out of gold (12 remains L3) and keeps the additive/acidification exclusions honest. The alternative - keeping the plasma pair - requires wording that admits in-place upgrading, and then GasAbate N+ and Treat2ReUse have to be re-adjudicated.

findings.claim: NOMAD (863000) satisfies the question and the drafter's three-part rule, and the recorded reason for excluding it ('treats generic biogas digestate; does not name livestock manure as an input') is contradicted by the project's own text.
findings.evidence: get_project_text 863000 report summary, verbatim: 'As feed, digestates from different origins (agricultural, animal residues, food waste, municipal waste) were used and the products of the process (solid fraction of processed digestate) were evaluated as soil improvers in greenhouse trials with local agricultural soils, providing similar or higher yields compared to commercial organic fertilizers.' Objective: 'recover fibre and specific nutrients from digestate for formulation into high performance bio-fertiliser products... The remaining sludge will be blended and composted with ash... to produce optimised, nutrient-balanced soil conditioners. The project aims to replace non-renewable mineral fertilisers with low-carbon, organic equivalents.' That is (a) animal-residue digestate as a named input, (b) fertilising products as a stated objective, (c) a separated, composted, nutrient-balanced solid - the same evidentiary shape that puts SYSTEMIC in gold (SYSTEMIC's objective names only 'organic waste'; its manure evidence likewise lives in report workPerformed). The critic confirmed the drafter's contrast case holds for the other two of the trio: BIOFERLUDAN 652017 has no manure/livestock/slurry token anywhere in objective or report, and ADFU 854814's only 'slurry' is digestate called slurry, so those two exclusions stand.
findings.fix_direction: Either add 863000 to gold (15 members, still L3, reference gains one sentence), or state a rule that excludes digestate-plant projects whose manure input is one of several named origins - but that rule then has to be applied to SYSTEMIC and UltraBio, which are in gold on the same footing.

Circular Agronomics matches sweep 1 on neither term: its objective has 'soil fertility' (not fertilis/fertiliz) and 'from livestock to cropland farming' (not a manure-family token). record.text: Which EU-funded projects take the slurry and droppings that pile up on livestock farms and turn them into a separate solid or concentrated fertilising product that farmers can store and spread on their crops in place of shop-bought mineral fertiliser, rather than just treating what comes off the farm so it works better as it is?
record.reference_answer: Thirteen projects set out to pull a distinct fertilising product out of livestock manure rather than leaving it as manure. Several are on-farm equipment from SMEs: ENFIR dehydrates manure with far-infrared heat into pelletized compost and organic fertilizer, more than 1.500 ton/year per unit; UltraBio applies ultrasound so that manure and digestate separate into a liquid fraction that can be disposed of freely and a nutrient-enriched solid that is pelletised and sold as a storable organic fertiliser; VALI burns manure on small poultry and horse farms for heat and electricity and leaves compact, easy-to-transport ashes directly usable as dry fertilizer; DEPURGAN treats pig slurry at its origin in an electrocoagulation reactor, yielding a solid fraction with calorific value plus an NPK liquid effluent; and IMBIO processes animal waste including chicken manure into high-quality organic fertilizers with a patented technology. NOMAD built a mobile digestate processing unit achieving up to 45% volume reduction, ammonium recovery and precipitation of struvite and hydroxyapatite, and its solid fraction matched or beat commercial organic fertilizers in greenhouse trials. The larger demonstration actions work along the value chain: FERTIMANURE runs five on-farm nutrient recovery pilots and targets 31 marketable end-products (11 bio-based and 20 tailor-made fertilisers); SYSTEMIC processes digestate of pig manure at Groot Zevert Vergisting into a mineral N fertiliser, an organic soil improver and a P fertiliser; Circular Agronomics developed five technologies including solar drying at TRL7 and struvite recovery at TRL6, keeping up to 62% of the N from manure digestate in the fertilizer product; NewFert converts ashes of different origins and livestock effluents into a new generation of fertilisers; and B-FERST builds 8 specialised fertilising products from streams including livestock manure compost. Poul-AR converts poultry manure into an ammonium salt directly applicable as fertilizer, and SUSTAINABLEFARM offers a modular waste-to-energy platform giving biogas plus organic fertilizers with the right nutritional properties.

why_good: This question discriminates on a line that surface similarity gets wrong in both directions: the corpus holds a dense cluster of manure projects that all talk about fertiliser and mineral-fertiliser replacement, and a system has to separate the ones that extract a distinct material (pellets, ash, solid fraction, recovered salts) from the ones that improve the slurry in place - plasma nitrogen fixation, acidification, storage additives - which are lexically the closest neighbours of all. It fills three axes the vector ladder does not touch (engineering and technology branch, environmental engineering bucket, agricultural inputs), with no colliding bank entry. The L3 survey label is arithmetic from |gold| = 13, and every member was individually read against a three-part rule that the question text now states on its face.

record.text: Which EU-funded projects take the slurry and droppings that pile up on livestock farms and turn them into a separate solid or concentrated fertilising product that farmers can store and spread on their crops in place of shop-bought mineral fertiliser, rather than just treating what comes off the farm so it works better as it is?
record.reference_answer: Thirteen projects set out to pull a distinct fertilising product out of livestock manure rather than leaving it as manure. Several are on-farm equipment from SMEs: ENFIR dehydrates manure with far-infrared heat into pelletized compost and organic fertilizer, more than 1.500 ton/year per unit; UltraBio applies ultrasound so that manure and digestate separate into a liquid fraction that can be disposed of freely and a nutrient-enriched solid that is pelletised and sold as a storable organic fertiliser; VALI burns manure on small poultry and horse farms for heat and electricity and leaves compact, easy-to-transport ashes directly usable as dry fertilizer; DEPURGAN treats pig slurry at its origin in an electrocoagulation reactor, yielding a solid fraction with calorific value plus an NPK liquid effluent; and IMBIO processes animal waste including chicken manure into high-quality organic fertilizers with a patented technology. NOMAD built a mobile digestate processing unit achieving up to 45% volume reduction, ammonium recovery and precipitation of struvite and hydroxyapatite, and its solid fraction matched or beat commercial organic fertilizers in greenhouse trials. The larger demonstration actions work along the value chain: FERTIMANURE runs five on-farm nutrient recovery pilots and targets 31 marketable end-products (11 bio-based and 20 tailor-made fertilisers); SYSTEMIC processes digestate of pig manure at Groot Zevert Vergisting into a mineral N fertiliser, an organic soil improver and a P fertiliser; Circular Agronomics developed five technologies including solar drying at TRL7 and struvite recovery at TRL6, keeping up to 62% of the N from manure digestate in the fertilizer product; NewFert converts ashes of different origins and livestock effluents into a new generation of fertilisers; and B-FERST builds 8 specialised fertilising products from streams including livestock manure compost. Poul-AR converts poultry manure into an ammonium salt directly applicable as fertilizer, and SUSTAINABLEFARM offers a modular waste-to-energy platform giving biogas plus organic fertilizers with the right nutritional properties.

record.text: Which EU-funded projects take the slurry and droppings that pile up on livestock farms and turn them into a separate solid or concentrated fertilising product that farmers can store and spread on their crops in place of shop-bought mineral fertiliser, rather than just treating what comes off the farm so it works better as it is?
record.reference_answer: Thirteen projects set out to pull a distinct fertilising product out of livestock manure rather than leaving it as manure. Several are on-farm equipment from SMEs: ENFIR dehydrates manure with far-infrared heat into pelletized compost and organic fertilizer, more than 1.500 ton/year per unit; UltraBio applies ultrasound so that manure and digestate separate into a liquid fraction that can be disposed of freely and a nutrient-enriched solid that is pelletised and sold as a storable organic fertiliser; VALI burns manure on small poultry and horse farms for heat and electricity and leaves compact, easy-to-transport ashes directly usable as dry fertilizer; DEPURGAN treats pig slurry at its origin in an electrocoagulation reactor, yielding a solid fraction with calorific value plus an NPK liquid effluent; and IMBIO processes animal waste including chicken manure into high-quality organic fertilizers with a patented technology. NOMAD built a mobile digestate processing unit achieving up to 45% volume reduction, ammonium recovery and precipitation of struvite and hydroxyapatite, and its solid fraction matched or beat commercial organic fertilizers in greenhouse trials. The larger demonstration actions work along the value chain: FERTIMANURE runs five on-farm nutrient recovery pilots and targets 31 marketable end-products (11 bio-based and 20 tailor-made fertilisers); SYSTEMIC processes digestate of pig manure at Groot Zevert Vergisting into a mineral N fertiliser, an organic soil improver and a P fertiliser; Circular Agronomics developed five technologies including solar drying at TRL7 and struvite recovery at TRL6, keeping up to 62% of the N from manure digestate in the fertilizer product; NewFert converts ashes of different origins and livestock effluents into a new generation of fertilisers; and B-FERST builds 8 specialised fertilising products from streams including livestock manure compost. Poul-AR converts poultry manure into an ammonium salt directly applicable as fertilizer, and SUSTAINABLEFARM offers a modular waste-to-energy platform giving biogas plus organic fertilizers with the right nutritional properties.

record.text: Which EU-funded projects put in place, as part of their own work, engineered planted treatment systems for water - beds, ponds or modules filled with gravel, sand or soil and planted with vegetation, through which the water to be cleaned is passed so that the plants and the microbes around their roots do the treating with little or no energy input - rather than only studying or restoring natural marshes?
record.reference_answer: Sixteen EU-funded projects put such systems in place. A decentralised, near-zero-energy sewage strand is the largest: iMETland built a full-scale device treating urban wastewater from small communities at zero-energy operation cost by combining electroactive bacteria and an electroconductive material with the biofilter bed, reaching depuration rates 10-fold higher than classical techniques; ELECTRAMMOX extends that METland concept to anaerobic ammonium oxidation for N removal; ELECTRA ran electrochemically enhanced versions to remove pharmaceutical residues; M-NBS markets modular, portable planted units for areas of Eastern Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia lacking sanitation; and alchemia-nova's VertECO work develops indoor and outdoor plant-based units for household grey-water. Others target a named contaminant or water source: ZIRONITRO's planted ponds remove nitrate from groundwater (98% removal, 84% lower cost than current solutions), TOXICROP reports clearance of toxic cyanobacteria on the order of 94% and about 99% removal rates of the toxin microcystins, INDIA-H2O constructed phyto-treatment for saline groundwater and industrial wastewater in Gujarat, and M2EX used such beds to polish bioleaching effluent for irrigation reuse. The rest embed them in larger water systems: AquaNES combines them with ozone or bioreactor pre- and post-treatment across 13 demonstration sites, HYDROUSA couples them with anaerobic processes and ultraviolet (UV) disinfection, INCOVER, PAVITRA GANGA, MULTISOURCE (seven pilots) and NICE (15 pilots, including hybrid subsurface systems alongside vertical gardens and rain gardens) demonstrate them for urban and peri-urban water reuse, and WATERAGRI tests farm-scale versions among its affordable water-retention and nutrient-recovery measures.
record.notes: Seeds: the six projects whose objective/title carry the specialist label (642190 iMETland, 689450 AquaNES, 701542 UMIC, 773351 ZIRONITRO, 858375 WATERAGRI, 894525 ELECTRAMMOX); drift check re-executed this pass and returned exactly those six. Membership line, stated in the question text: the project itself builds, operates or tests a planted treatment unit (bed, pond or module of gravel/sand/soil with vegetation) through which water is passed to be cleaned; studies of natural marshes and of their restoration are out. Applied identically to every candidate, using objective AND report_text (teaser/summary/workPerformed/finalResults) as qualifying evidence. OUT with reason: 701542 UMIC (seed, dropped - studies uranium colloid geochemistry in natural wetland environments, including wetlands not impacted by anthropogenic activities; builds nothing), 660391 OPTWET (siting of wetland restoration for nutrient removal - restoration, not a built treatment unit), 642228 SUBSOL (subsurface water wells; wetlands only named as ecosystems at risk), 704957 NANOREM (ZnO nanoparticle toxicity in wetland plants), 751692 BIRDBARRIER (reed beds as bird habitat), 788009 IRMIDYN (iron mineral redox in natural wetlands/floodplains), 817155 Aqua Gratis (domestic grey-water recycling by biocide dosing, no planted stage), 858378 EPSETECH (chemical metal precipitation), 101000348 DIVAGRI (an 'artificial wetland' is one of seven technologies, but the report calls it a water SAVING technology and states no treatment duty), 734409 Water4Cities (models NBS locations), 842460 PROTEAN (urban agriculture LCA), 101006717 CERESiS and 826312 GREENER (phytoremediation of contaminated SOIL, not a water-treatment bed), 101028018 SPONGE (stormwater infiltration, microplastics), 101036484 WaterLANDS (restoration of natural wetlands - the exclusion clause's target), 689817 INNOQUA (earthworm lumbrifilter sanitation, no planted bed), 691402 RichWater, 776816 Project O, 673683 EBBR, 690323 SMART-Plant, 672596 algaPLUS, 685793 MIDES, 816085 MEMBio, 827658 ACT, 718070 EKO_MEMOF, 743055 CPB 4.0, 897344 CLEAR, 674455 GReen Desalination, 945638 RIBATI (all engineered reactor/membrane/algal water treatment with no planted bed), plus root-biology, soil and unrelated pooled noise (RhizoSheet, MICRORULES, RINFEC, SENSE, RhizoEng, DiverseRoots, Xerobranching, StoiCa, FLAME, MarshFlux, MicroCity, MYRES, MICROREAL, FTI Cocoon, ROMI, SMARTSAND, BALANCE, NOBILIS, Res2Pel, HardALU, NaToxAq, KNOWPEC, TRITRONITRO, AQUACOMBINE, CERESiS). record.text: Which EU-funded projects put in place, as part of their own work, engineered planted treatment systems for water - beds, ponds or modules filled with gravel, sand or soil and planted with vegetation, through which the water to be cleaned is passed so that the plants and the microbes around their roots do the treating with little or no energy input - rather than only studying or restoring natural marshes?
record.reference_answer: Sixteen EU-funded projects put such systems in place. A decentralised, near-zero-energy sewage strand is the largest: iMETland built a full-scale device treating urban wastewater from small communities at zero-energy operation cost by combining electroactive bacteria and an electroconductive material with the biofilter bed, reaching depuration rates 10-fold higher than classical techniques; ELECTRAMMOX extends that METland concept to anaerobic ammonium oxidation for N removal; ELECTRA ran electrochemically enhanced versions to remove pharmaceutical residues; M-NBS markets modular, portable planted units for areas of Eastern Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia lacking sanitation; and alchemia-nova's VertECO work develops indoor and outdoor plant-based units for household grey-water. Others target a named contaminant or water source: ZIRONITRO's planted ponds remove nitrate from groundwater (98% removal, 84% lower cost than current solutions), TOXICROP reports clearance of toxic cyanobacteria on the order of 94% and about 99% removal rates of the toxin microcystins, INDIA-H2O constructed phyto-treatment for saline groundwater and industrial wastewater in Gujarat, and M2EX used such beds to polish bioleaching effluent for irrigation reuse. The rest embed them in larger water systems: AquaNES combines them with ozone or bioreactor pre- and post-treatment across 13 demonstration sites, HYDROUSA couples them with anaerobic processes and ultraviolet (UV) disinfection, INCOVER, PAVITRA GANGA, MULTISOURCE (seven pilots) and NICE (15 pilots, including hybrid subsurface systems alongside vertical gardens and rain gardens) demonstrate them for urban and peri-urban water reuse, and WATERAGRI tests farm-scale versions among its affordable water-retention and nutrient-recovery measures.
record.notes: Seeds: the six projects whose objective/title carry the specialist label (642190 iMETland, 689450 AquaNES, 701542 UMIC, 773351 ZIRONITRO, 858375 WATERAGRI, 894525 ELECTRAMMOX); drift check re-executed this pass and returned exactly those six. Membership line, stated in the question text: the project itself builds, operates or tests a planted treatment unit (bed, pond or module of gravel/sand/soil with vegetation) through which water is passed to be cleaned; studies of natural marshes and of their restoration are out. Applied identically to every candidate, using objective AND report_text (teaser/summary/workPerformed/finalResults) as qualifying evidence. OUT with reason: 701542 UMIC (seed, dropped - studies uranium colloid geochemistry in natural wetland environments, including wetlands not impacted by anthropogenic activities; builds nothing), 660391 OPTWET (siting of wetland restoration for nutrient removal - restoration, not a built treatment unit), 642228 SUBSOL (subsurface water wells; wetlands only named as ecosystems at risk), 704957 NANOREM (ZnO nanoparticle toxicity in wetland plants), 751692 BIRDBARRIER (reed beds as bird habitat), 788009 IRMIDYN (iron mineral redox in natural wetlands/floodplains), 817155 Aqua Gratis (domestic grey-water recycling by biocide dosing, no planted stage), 858378 EPSETECH (chemical metal precipitation), 101000348 DIVAGRI (an 'artificial wetland' is one of seven technologies, but the report calls it a water SAVING technology and states no treatment duty), 734409 Water4Cities (models NBS locations), 842460 PROTEAN (urban agriculture LCA), 101006717 CERESiS and 826312 GREENER (phytoremediation of contaminated SOIL, not a water-treatment bed), 101028018 SPONGE (stormwater infiltration, microplastics), 101036484 WaterLANDS (restoration of natural wetlands - the exclusion clause's target), 689817 INNOQUA (earthworm lumbrifilter sanitation, no planted bed), 691402 RichWater, 776816 Project O, 673683 EBBR, 690323 SMART-Plant, 672596 algaPLUS, 685793 MIDES, 816085 MEMBio, 827658 ACT, 718070 EKO_MEMOF, 743055 CPB 4.0, 897344 CLEAR, 674455 GReen Desalination, 945638 RIBATI (all engineered reactor/membrane/algal water treatment with no planted bed), plus root-biology, soil and unrelated pooled noise (RhizoSheet, MICRORULES, RINFEC, SENSE, RhizoEng, DiverseRoots, Xerobranching, StoiCa, FLAME, MarshFlux, MicroCity, MYRES, MICROREAL, FTI Cocoon, ROMI, SMARTSAND, BALANCE, NOBILIS, Res2Pel, HardALU, NaToxAq, KNOWPEC, TRITRONITRO, AQUACOMBINE, CERESiS). record.text: Which EU-funded projects put in place, as part of their own work, engineered planted treatment systems for water - beds, ponds or modules filled with gravel, sand or soil and planted with vegetation, through which the water to be cleaned is passed so that the plants and the microbes around their roots do the treating with little or no energy input - rather than only studying or restoring natural marshes?
record.reference_answer: Sixteen EU-funded projects put such systems in place. A decentralised, near-zero-energy sewage strand is the largest: iMETland built a full-scale device treating urban wastewater from small communities at zero-energy operation cost by combining electroactive bacteria and an electroconductive material with the biofilter bed, reaching depuration rates 10-fold higher than classical techniques; ELECTRAMMOX extends that METland concept to anaerobic ammonium oxidation for N removal; ELECTRA ran electrochemically enhanced versions to remove pharmaceutical residues; M-NBS markets modular, portable planted units for areas of Eastern Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia lacking sanitation; and alchemia-nova's VertECO work develops indoor and outdoor plant-based units for household grey-water. Others target a named contaminant or water source: ZIRONITRO's planted ponds remove nitrate from groundwater (98% removal, 84% lower cost than current solutions), TOXICROP reports clearance of toxic cyanobacteria on the order of 94% and about 99% removal rates of the toxin microcystins, INDIA-H2O constructed phyto-treatment for saline groundwater and industrial wastewater in Gujarat, and M2EX used such beds to polish bioleaching effluent for irrigation reuse. The rest embed them in larger water systems: AquaNES combines them with ozone or bioreactor pre- and post-treatment across 13 demonstration sites, HYDROUSA couples them with anaerobic processes and ultraviolet (UV) disinfection, INCOVER, PAVITRA GANGA, MULTISOURCE (seven pilots) and NICE (15 pilots, including hybrid subsurface systems alongside vertical gardens and rain gardens) demonstrate them for urban and peri-urban water reuse, and WATERAGRI tests farm-scale versions among its affordable water-retention and nutrient-recovery measures.
record.notes: Seeds: the six projects whose objective/title carry the specialist label (642190 iMETland, 689450 AquaNES, 701542 UMIC, 773351 ZIRONITRO, 858375 WATERAGRI, 894525 ELECTRAMMOX); drift check re-executed this pass and returned exactly those six. Membership line, stated in the question text: the project itself builds, operates or tests a planted treatment unit (bed, pond or module of gravel/sand/soil with vegetation) through which water is passed to be cleaned; studies of natural marshes and of their restoration are out. Applied identically to every candidate, using objective AND report_text (teaser/summary/workPerformed/finalResults) as qualifying evidence. judge_decisions.rationale: GOLD-WRONG UPHELD: 854782's workPerformed shows the grant bought a market analysis, a commercial strategy and a freedom-to-operate check, with the objective attributing the 100-plus deployments to the company before the grant, so M-NBS fails the question's own 'put in place, as part of their own work' clause; the DIVAGRI asymmetry shows the line is not being applied identically. MISSED-GOLD UPHELD: GROW GREEN's constructed rain gardens and swales with monitored water-quality improvement are the same shape as the rain-garden evidence that helps carry NICE into gold, and the only thing keeping it out is a stormwater-versus-wastewater distinction present in neither the question text nor the stated rule.
